content.short: An Explorer to search data in the Cardano Blockchain. It is made to be fast and simple providing raw data.
content.description:
Raw Cardano Explorer is a simple and fast app to search the Cardano Blockchain. You can search using any data from a given transaction, Pool, Wallet, Epoch, Block, an Asset... and more. This App is made by Quixote Dream Pool Team and is free for the whole Cardano Community.

If you like using our explorer, share and Delegate in Quixote Dream Pool [QXT].
